Friday, which earlier nations differed over, was given to this nation; whoever attends should bathe, use siwak and perfume, come early and listen silently, his sins since last Friday forgiven.
The Prophet recited As-Sajda and Ad-Dahr in Friday's Fajr; the next Jumua after his mosque's was at Jawathi in Bahrain; a governor is told to lead Jumua, all being guardians.
Whoever comes to Jumua should bathe, a duty on all past puberty; Friday was given to this nation after others differed, and every Muslim should bathe once in seven days.
On a muddy day Ibn Abbas had people pray at home though Jumua is compulsory; bathing was urged on workers arriving dusty and sweaty; Jumua was prayed soon after midday.
Feet dusty in Allah's cause are saved from Hell; walk calmly to the prayer; whoever bathes and does not push between two people is forgiven; none may unseat another.
The Friday Adhan was called once the imam sat on the pulpit, until Uthman added one at Az-Zawra; Muawiya repeated the Adhan's words from the pulpit, as the Prophet did.
An Ansari woman's slave carpenter made the pulpit of tamarisk; the Prophet prayed on it to teach, the palm stem he stood by cried, and he preached standing, sitting between.
The Prophet gave two sermons, sitting between them; angels record Friday arrivals by the hour, then listen; a man entering during the sermon is told to pray two rak'at.
Telling a companion to be quiet during the sermon is wrong; Friday holds a short hour when requests are granted; people left for a food caravan, and a verse came.
After Jumua the companions ate a woman's dish of silq roots and barley, looking forward to Friday; they napped and ate only after the Jumua prayer, which was prayed early.
The companions were happy on Fridays because an old woman served them cooked silq roots after the Friday prayer, before which they took neither meals nor the midday nap.
Muslims, last to come, will be foremost at the Resurrection; earlier nations differed over Friday, Saturday going to the Jews and Sunday to the Christians; Muslims must bathe weekly.
A caravan arrived on a Friday and all but twelve left the Prophet for it, and the verse on people dispersing headlong to a bargain was revealed.
On Friday there is a moment when a Muslim who is praying and asks Allah for some good is granted it.
The companions took their midday nap and their meals after the Friday prayer.
On Friday there is a brief time when Allah grants whatever good a Muslim who is praying asks of Him.
